chunks: Abu Basir narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
"Do not let the Imam hear your supplication behind him."

key_terms.أَحَدِهِمَا: one of the two Imams referred to in the chain
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.تُسْمِعَنَّ: do not cause to be heard
key_terms.خَلْفَهُ: behind him, meaning behind the Imam in prayer

ai.seo_question: Should a person behind the Imam make supplication loudly enough for the Imam to hear?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs the follower in congregational salat to avoid making supplication in a way that the Imam can hear from behind him. It indicates an etiquette and legal restraint related to conduct during congregational prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1188 - Abu Basir narrated from one of the Imams (as) who said:
"Do not let the Imam hear your supplication behind him”.
